page.aboutOrganizationHint: A community organization shaped by crisis response and continuity.
page.aboutOrganizationHeroIntro: NSP grew from volunteer relief into a structured social welfare organization. Its work now spans child welfare, women’s support, disability care, education, rehabilitation, and awareness-led community development.
page.founderMessageIntro1: I am pleased to share NSP’s journey of care, resilience, and service. What began as an urgent response to suffering has matured into a centre of consistent support for vulnerable children, women, persons with disabilities, older adults, and families in distress.
page.founderMessageIntro2: Our work has never been about one intervention alone. We continue to combine shelter, food, education, health care, counseling, awareness, and rehabilitation so that people can move from dependence toward dignity and participation.
page.founderMessageIntro3: None of this is possible without the support of our staff, partners, donors, volunteers, and governing members. Their commitment keeps the organization accountable and mission-driven.
page.founderMessageSignatureNote: A steady commitment to equal opportunity, rehabilitation, and human dignity.
page.aboutOrganizationVisionTitle: A society built on dignity, health, learning, and equal opportunity.
page.aboutOrganizationVisionBody1: In our envisioned future, we see a society that stands as a beacon of hope and progress, characterized by its unwavering commitment to the well-being of its citizens. This society places paramount importance on health, ensuring that every individual enjoys access to quality healthcare, both as a fundamental right and a cornerstone of human dignity.
page.aboutOrganizationVisionBody2: Education is the bedrock upon which this vision is built, fostering intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, and a love for lifelong learning. It is a system that leaves no one behind, equipping every person with the knowledge and skills they need to not only survive, but to thrive in an ever-evolving world. Empowerment is woven into the fabric of this society, breaking down barriers and amplifying the voices of the marginalized.
page.aboutOrganizationMissionTitle: Grassroots empowerment through care, capacity, and self-reliance.
page.aboutOrganizationMissionBody1: Our mission is dedicated to uplifting individuals at the grassroots level by focusing on enhancing their capacities and addressing their diverse needs and challenges. This empowerment is achieved through both individual and collective efforts, recognizing that supporting communities as a whole is just as important as aiding individuals.
page.aboutOrganizationMissionBody2: The ultimate goal is to foster self-sufficiency, allowing people to become self-reliant and independent. Central to our mission is the belief in ensuring the well-being and dignity of every individual, promoting long-term health, prosperity, equality, self-respect, and meaningful community contribution.
page.aboutOrganizationObjectivesSubtitle: Practical interventions that turn commitment into structured support.
page.aboutOrganizationObjectivesBody: Our objectives center around implementing scalable interventions in collaboration with government and various agencies, demonstrating a comprehensive approach to community development.
page.aboutOrganizationObjectiveList1: Skill enhancement and capacity-building for better economic opportunity.
page.aboutOrganizationObjectiveList2: Disability rehabilitation, care, and inclusive support systems.
page.aboutOrganizationObjectiveList3: Women’s empowerment, rehabilitation, and social defense.
page.aboutOrganizationObjectiveList4: Child care, rehabilitation, and dignified support for older persons.
page.aboutOrganizationTargetSubtitle: Focused on people who face exclusion, vulnerability, or neglect.
page.aboutOrganizationTargetBody1: Our organization is a beacon of hope and support for a diverse range of individuals facing various challenges in society. From persons with disabilities to vulnerable children, destitute women, and senior citizens, NSP extends a caring hand to those who need it most.
page.aboutOrganizationTargetBody2: The outreach also includes youth, people affected by alcoholism or drug abuse, and other disadvantaged groups who need protection, rehabilitation, and a stronger pathway back into community life.
page.aboutOrganizationWorkBody: NSP works with families, institutions, volunteers, and public systems to create responses that are practical, humane, and sustainable.
page.aboutOrganizationApproachList1: Relief and rehabilitation for vulnerable groups.
page.aboutOrganizationApproachList2: Skill-building, care services, and awareness campaigns.
page.aboutOrganizationApproachList3: Programs that connect dignity with opportunity.
page.aboutOrganizationReachBody: The organization operates from Benagaon in Kanas block and serves people across Odisha through targeted, need-based programs.
page.briefProfileHeroIntro: The live site presents NSP as a long-standing service organization with deep roots in Odisha, a practical care model, and a wide set of welfare programmes. This profile captures that story in a cleaner, modern format.
page.briefProfileQuote: The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.
page.briefProfileFoundingStory: The devastating cyclone of 1978, accompanied by a prolonged drought and a huge flood in 1980, left a significant number of people in a state of shock and destitution in Odisha. In the face of such adversity, a team of grass-roots volunteers, inspired by the Gandhian philosophy, came forward to assist thousands of victims by collecting relief materials from individual donors to meet their basic needs and aid their recovery. The tremendous outpouring of humanitarian aid and philanthropic initiative motivated these volunteers to establish "Nilachal Seva Pratisthan (NSP)," an organization dedicated to the values of equality, justice, and peace. Later, NSP was registered under the Indian Societies Registration Act XXI of 1860, vide Registration No.226/13 on 26.04.1981. Since then, NSP has been unwavering in its commitment to implement various welfare activities and programs for socio-economic, health, environmental and human resource development. Seva (service to mankind) and Daya (sympathy and empathy for the destitute and marginalized sections of society) are our core values guiding our social actions. From its inception, NSP has relentlessly pursued welfare and developmental activities to alleviate the concerns, issues and problems affecting the underprivileged and disadvantaged segments of society. NSP has been the recipient of awards and commendations for its exceptional accomplishments and accredited by Credibility Alliance for Good Governance.
page.briefProfileMembershipBody: Membership at District/State/National level: Indian Red Cross society (OSB), State Mental Health Authority, District Child Labour Prevention Committee, Council of Higher Secondary Education (Odisha), NSS Advisory Committee, Programme Advisory Committee(PAC) of DIET (Puri), District Aadhaar committee (for welfare of older persons), Puri District Local Level Committee of National Trust E.C., Voluntary Co-ordination Committee for Adoption, Member of Governing Body of District Rural Development Agency (DRDA)-Puri. District ICP Society; & District ICP Council, District SC/ST Atrocities Prevention Committee, being a pioneering Voluntary Organization.
page.briefProfileLocationBody: NSP is located 35 kilometers away from the district headquarter and beach town Puri on the coast line of Bay of Bengal and 55 kilometers from Capital City Bhubaneswar/Airport by road ways. Located in a green, calm and soulful site besides the bank of river Daya, the exact geography is 1.5 kilometer North-east to Jankia - Gadasahi Square at New Jagannath Sadak (Puri-Saranakul National Highway) in the block of Kanas. Constructed over an area of 27 acres of own land and more than 1.72 lakh Sft. built up space including a satisfactory asset base to operationalize different projects in an ambient environment including all basic amenities for residential units and offices etc. Other than the day to day usable amenities, facilities, office equipment, furniture & fixtures, etc., the organisation holds 2.62 Crores fixed assets as on 31.03.2023. The organization is surrounded with lovely coconut trees and vast green paddy fields. The whole environment splashes the typical fragrance of rural habitation where the Soul of India Lives in.
